wiki.quote: What I've seen goes far beyond death.

entries.name: Ancient Apparition
lines: Ice Blast prevents Death Prophet from gaining health from Spirit Siphon and Exorcism.

However, there is a way for Death Prophet to counter Ice Blast: Since Death Prophet is not healed until the spirits are returned to her. She can attempt to outrun her spirits to delay their return until Ice Blast duration runs out.

entries.name: Anti-Mage
lines: Death Prophet has a high mana pool and due to her heavy reliance on her spells, she will be a prime target for Mana Void.
Death Prophet has less mobility than Anti-Mage due to Blink.

entries.name: Doom
lines: Doom can stop Death Prophet from casting spells, which makes her useless during team fights if she didn't cast Exorcism before the fight, and also nullifies healing from Exorcism and Spirit Syphon. Furthermore, Doom can use Scorched Earth to chase after her.

entries.name: Legion Commander
lines: Duel is a great initiation to kill Death Prophet before she can cast Exorcism. Furthermore, Legion Commander often builds Blade Mail and can reflect Exorcism's damage to kill Death Prophet easily.

entries.name: Omniknight
lines: Guardian Angel nullifies the physical damage from Exorcism during teamfights. And when upgraded with Aghanim's Scepter, it also prevents Death Prophet from pushing towers. However, Death Prophet can partially counter this issue with Eul's Scepter of Divinity, a common item on Death Prophet.
Heavenly Grace dispels Silence.

entries.name: Shadow Fiend
lines: Shadowraze (Near), Shadowraze (Medium), and Shadowraze (Far) can hit hard in the early stages of the game, and due to Shadow Fiend's high attack damage, most of Death Prophet's last hits will be denied in the laning phase. Additionally, Requiem of Souls can deal massive damage or kill Death Prophet at the start of team fights in combination with Eul's Scepter of Divinity or Shadow Blade.
Generally, without Exorcism, Death Prophet can contribute very little during teamfights, especially when she has been silenced, hexed or is focused down.
Riki is another good hero to shutdown Death Prophet with Diffusal Blade as his core item. His Smoke Screen stops her from initiating and casting spells.
Heroes that can kill Death Prophet with nukes can prevent her from using Exorcism to its full duration or using it at all: Lina, Lion, Puck, Morphling.

Blade Mail can reflect Exorcism's damage when active. Since Exorcism will continue to do damage as long as it is active or until Death Prophet is dead there is no way for her to stop someone from using Blade Mail's active to harm her using Exorcism.
Orchid Malevolence and Bloodthorn can temporarily stop Death Prophet from casting spells, which renders Death Prophet useless during fights unless Death Prophet buys a dispelling item.
Diffusal Blade can slow her down and drain her mana while attacking.
Eul's Scepter of Divinity, Guardian Greaves, Lotus Orb, Manta Style can easily dispel Death Prophet's silence.

Ethereal Blade can be used to disarm Death Prophet and make her more vulnerable to magical damage, it also can be used to protect it's owner from Exorcism. However, Death Prophet can counter this with Crypt Swarm and Spirit Siphon, which deal magical damage.

entries.name: Bounty Hunter
lines: Death Prophet's Silence allows her to prevent Bounty Hunter from escaping with Shadow Walk.
If Bounty Hunter cannot escape with Shadow Walk while affected by Silence, she will be able to burst him down with Crypt Swarm and Spirit Siphon.

entries.name: Clockwerk
lines: Spirit Siphon can deal some serious damage to Clockwerk while he is in Power Cogs while healing Death Prophet in process. Exorcism can also be used to take down Clockwerk faster while he is in Power Cogs.
Death Prophet usually buys a Hurricane Pike or Eul's Scepter of Divinity which allows her to easily escape from Power Cogs or save her allies from Clockwerk.
Silence can prevent Clockwerk from using his ablities during teamfight, especially since Clockwerk is an easy target for it while in Power Cogs.

entries.name: Chen
lines: Silence will prevent Chen from activating Hand of God.
Crypt Swarm and Exorcism can clear Chen's creeps and heavily damage Chen.
Spirit Siphon heavily damages Chen and slows him, while healing Death Prophet.

entries.name: Invoker
lines: Quas-Exort Invoker is also a good matchup due to the fact he has no Wex to run faster due to the movement impairment on his stealth. The Forge Spirit and Cold Snap combo doesn't harm her as well since you can drain Invoker's HP with Spirit Siphon which forces him to retreat.

Silence also prevents Invoker from using Invoke or casting his main spells temporarily. There is no way Invoker can block it unless he has Eul's Scepter of Divinity to cyclone himself or has help from allies.

entries.name: Morphling
lines: While Morphling can burst her down with Adaptive Strike (Agility), Death Prophet does have tools to disrupt him. A Morphling affected by Silence makes it unable to use Attribute Shift (Strength Gain) to increase its health pool or use Waveform to escape.

entries.name: Timbersaw
lines: Because Timbersaw relies heavily on his spells to deal damage, Silence can easily disable him in a team fight.
Exorcism's spirits do not count as regular attacks, and will not add stacks of Reactive Armor.

entries.name: Nature's Prophet
lines: Crypt Swarm helps clear waves of Treants.
Silence prevents Nature's Prophet from using Sprout or Teleportation.
Exorcism kills Treants with ease.

In early to mid stage, Silence is also a great way to counter escape oriented heroes such as Anti-Mage, Queen of Pain_new, and Phantom Assassin to prevent them from escaping, provided that they don't have any basic dispels.
Spirit Siphon does a lot of magical damage, especially in the early game. This allows her to demolish low health heroes such as Thor, Pugna, especially when combined with her other spells.
Because Exorcism's damage is not reduce by damage block abilities or items, Death Prophet can be very good against heroes who rely on armor to survive: Axe, Terrorblade, Morphling, Fairy Knight

While Ethereal Blade can be used to disarm Death Prophet and make her more vulnerable to magical damage and to protect it's owner from Exorcism. Death Prophet can counter this with Crypt Swarm and Spirit Siphon, which deal magical damage.
Crimson Guard cannot reduce damage from Exorcism.

entries.name: Enigma
lines: Black Hole disables enemies and allows Death Prophet to deal a lot of damage with Exorcism. It can be used as counter-initiation if Death Prophet is focused first in teamfights.

entries.name: Faceless Void
lines: Chronosphere allows Death Prophet to deal a lot of damage with Exorcism. Even if Death Prophet is caught inside the Chronosphere, the spirits will still continue to move and do damage.

entries.name: Keeper of the Light
lines: Solar Bind has perfect synergy with Death Prophet since it slows enemies, preventing them from kiting her. It also reduces magic resistance which can make Crypt Swarm and Spirit Siphon more potent.
Chakra Magic reduces the lengthy cooldown of Spirit Siphon. Also, it tops off her mana pool since she often has mana problems.
Will-O-Wisp synergizes extremely well with Death Prophet's AoE abilities, especially Exorcism.

entries.name: Sven
lines: Great Cleave and Exorcism can easily clear waves of creeps, summons and illusions.
Warcry can give Death Prophet bonus armor during the teamfights, for she is very frail and cannot endure a lot if she gets focused.
Silence prevents enemy heroes from using abilites against Sven in attempts to counter-initiate against him.
God's Strength and Exorcism can very quickly make a short work out of enemy heroes and buildings alike.
Heroes with strong defensive abilities (Dazzle, Oracle, etc.) can help Death Prophet survive longer to deal more damage and even heal herself when Exorcism ends.

Initiators with large AoE crowd control effects are fantastic with Death Prophet as they keep enemies still for Exorcism. The spirits from Exorcism are also capable of taking down towers quickly so she works well with others who are also capable of pushing quickly and destroying buildings.

Heroes with abilities to summon units such as Lycan, Lone Druid or able to control neutral creeps such as Chen, Enchantress also are a great way to help Death Prophet push and destroy enemy buildings.

entries.name: Clarity
lines: Clarity allows Death Prophet to keep using Crypt Swarm.

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango provides health regeneration to keep Death Prophet in lane.

entries.name: Healing Salve
lines: Healing Salve also restores health.

entries.name: Iron Branch
lines: Iron Branch gives intelligence that boosts mana pool and attack damage to last hit; Death Prophet can use it with Tango to heal more.

entries.name: Magic Stick
lines: Magic Stick is generally good to pick up because even minimum charges can mean the difference between casting a spell or not.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed allows Death Prophet to be more efficient at ganking early.

entries.name: Magic Wand
lines: Magic Wand is a fairly inexpensive upgrade to the early Iron Branches and Magic Stick that provides an extra heal.

entries.name: Null Talisman
lines: Null Talisman increases Death Prophet's mana pool, as well as giving some extra health and damage.

entries.name: Phase Boots
lines: Phase Boots has strong synergy with Death Prophet's movement speed.

entries.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
lines: Eul's Scepter of Divinity is an amazing item on Death Prophet as it gives movement speed, mana, and a way to disable an enemy or herself. When paired with Exorcism, Death Prophet can be kept out of combat while her spirits do massive damage to enemies.

entries.name: Force Staff
lines: Force Staff will give Death Prophet extra intelligence and health. And it's active ability will help Death Prophet escape from ganks or chase after enemy heroes. Force Staff can later be upgraded into Hurricane Pike that can do the same while also increasing Death Prophet's attack range.

entries.name: Black King Bar
lines: Black King Bar gives a boost to HP as well as the ability to get in the middle of team fights, where Exorcism can deal the most damage.

entries.name: Drum of Endurance
lines: Drum of Endurance gives good attribute boosts for the price as well as even more movement and attack speed for her team.

entries.name: Witch Blade
lines: Witch Blade is an exceptionally important item for Death Prophet to have as her durability is low and her attack projectile speed is awfully slow. Witch Blade will give Death Prophet more armor to withstand more damage, more intelligence to use her abilities more often, more attack speed to attack more often, true strike every 9 seconds, and will increase the travelling speed of her attack projecitles. Witch Blade can later be upgraded into Revenant's Brooch that can be activated to give Death Prophet true strike for her next five attacks that can also deal magic damage, weaken magic resistance and attack ethereal units.

entries.name: Octarine Core
lines: Octarine Core allows Death Prophet to use her abilities more frequently in fights, and reduces the time she has to wait between fights for Exorcism to come off cooldown.

entries.name: Wind Waker
lines: Wind Waker, an upgrade for Eul's Scepter of Divinity will improve Death Prophet's escape tool, and will also allow it to save her allies from bad situations.

entries.name: Shiva's Guard
lines: Shiva's Guard gives Death Prophet another nuke, as well as a larger mana pool and more armor, both of which she needs. It also allows Death Prophet to reduce any healing enemy heroes receive.

entries.name: Silver Edge
lines: Silver Edge will give Death Prophet attack speed, chance to deal critical strikes and to have her next attack apply a break that will disable enemy hero's passive abilities, as well as an escape tool. Silver Edge can be also activated during Exorcism to wreak havoc on unsuspecting enemies.

entries.name: Scythe of Vyse
lines: Scythe of Vyse will give Death Prophet a strong disable that will allow her to hex enemies, silencing them, disarming them and muting them, and will also give her a much larger mana pool.

entries.name: Aghanim's Scepter
lines: Aghanim's Scepter will allow Exorcism to passively summon a spirit that will slow, and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with a healing anytime she damages them with normal attacks, abilities and items, which can lessen her dependence on Exorcism to be effective in teamfights and pushing.

entries.name: Aghanim's Shard
lines: Aghanim's Shard will give Death Prophet an extra charge for Spirit Siphon and will also allow her to slow and fear enemies for 1.2 seconds if they are affected by Spirit Siphon for 3 seconds consecutively.

entries.name: Hurricane Pike
lines: Hurricane Pike will give Death Prophet a good amount of attributes, tool to escape from enemy heroes and to chase after them while also increasing her attack range.

entries.name: Revenant's Brooch
lines: Revenant's Brooch, an upgrade for Witch Blade will give Death Prophet a lot more intelligence, armor, attack speed, true strike every 9 seconds and increased travelling speed for her attack projectiles. Revenant's Brooch can be activated to make Death Prophet's next five attacks have true strike, deal magic damage while also weakening their magic resistance by 20% for 3 seconds, making them more vulnerable to Crypt Swarm and Spirit Siphon. And most importantly, Revenant's Brooch's active ability will allow Death Prophet to attack ethereal units who try to protect themselves with abilities and items that turn the user ethereal against Exorcism.

entries.name: Boots of Travel
lines: Boots of Travel will give Death Prophet lots of movement speed and will also allow her to teleport to almost any point of the map, which can be useful for split-pushing with Exorcism.

entries.name: Arcane Boots
lines: Arcane Boots can restore mana to Death Prophet and nearby allies. Later it can be either upgraded into Guardian Greaves that can do the same while also healing Death Prophet and nearby allies and apply a basic dispel on her. Or it can be disassembled and upgraded into Aether Lens for extra mana pool, mana regeneration and extra casting range and Boots of Travel for global presence, extra movement speed and split-pushing.

entries.name: Eternal Shroud
lines: Eternal Shroud significantly increases Death Prophet's durability against magic damage, as well as allowing her to recover health in fights with her abilities.

entries.name: Bloodstone
lines: Bloodstone provides exceptional mana regeneration, as well as spell amplification and spell lifesteal, allowing Death Prophet to stay in fights longer and freely use Crypt Swarm to farm and push lanes.

entries.name: Pipe of Insight
lines: Pipe of Insight is a notable pick up because of the health regeneration as well as magic resistance, and when paired with Mekansm, Death Prophet can turn around a losing fight, or create a strong initiation.

entries.name: Assault Cuirass
lines: Assault Cuirass will give Death Prophet bonus armor to withstand more damage, attack speed to attack faster and the ability to reduce armor of nearby enemies and buildings, which can boost the effect of Exorcism's physical damage output greatly.

entries.name: Aether Lens
lines: Aether Lens will give Death Prophet bonus mana and will also increase her mana regeneration and casting range for her abilities.

entries.name: Solar Crest
lines: Solar Crest slows and makes Exorcism do a lot more damage to a single target, as well as providing mana regeneration, armor, and attributes, which Death Prophet wants.

entries.name: Heart of Tarrasque
lines: Heart of Tarrasque will allow Death Prophet to stay in team-fights much longer by increasing her health, strength and health regeneration.

entries.name: Veil of Discord
lines: Veil of Discord will allow Death Prophet to cause enemies that get caught in it's blast radius to take bonus spell damage from her abilities, and will also give her bonus mana regeneration and attributes.

entries.name: Dagon
lines: Dagon will give Death Prophet nice attributes and a spell lifesteal that will allow her to heal herself with her abilities and additional magical damage burst that will allow her to finish off enemy heroes even faster.

entries.name: Kaya
lines: Kaya improves Death Prophet's damage output and lessens the strain on her mana pool. Can be built into Ethereal Blade for disarm and spell amplification.

entries.name: Ethereal Blade
lines: Ethereal Blade will give Death Prophet bonus intelligence and will also amplify her mana regeneration, spell amplification and will also allow her to disarm enemies and make them more vulnerable to Crypt Swarm's and Spirit Siphon's magical damage output, as well as defend herself against heroes who rely on direct attacks to deal damage. However, Exorcism will not be able to damage ethereal units as it's damage type is physical instead of magical.

entries.name: Rod of Atos
lines: Rod of Atos will give Death Prophet bonus health and intelligence while also allowing her to keep enemies within range of her spells, and makes it easier to land Silence. Rod of Atos can later be upgraded into Gleipnir for a root in an area and passive chain lightning.

entries.name: Gleipnir
lines: Gleipnir, an upgrade for Rod of Atos, will give Death Prophet the ability to root enemies in an area while also allowing her normal attacks to release a chain lightning that can bounce between enemies and damage them.

pros: Can push lanes and destroy towers quickly.
High base movement speed allows her to chase enemies.
playstyle.text: Death Prophet is a powerful spell-caster, who has wide Area of Effect (AoE) spells which specialize in pushing lanes and also devastating enemy defensive towers quickly in order to enter their enemy base, to gain victory within a short period of time. Exorcism can devastate towers in a short period of time, while also being a great ability for teamfights. To keep herself alive, she can use Silence and Spirit Siphon to remain active while still dealing damage.
cons: Long cast animation besides Spirit Siphon.

lines: Death Prophet's main role is usually a pusher. With the combination of low cooldown Crypt Swarm spam can quickly clear waves of creeps and Exorcism allows her to destroy towers quickly to push the lanes faster. She can be paired up with other pusher heroes that can summon units like Nature's Prophet's Nature's Call Treant, Enigma's Demonic Conversion Eidolons, Broodmother's Spawn Spiderlings Spiderlings etc. which can devastate enemy towers and barracks quickly.

Death Prophet also can be played as a sub-tank or support-tank. A focus on health boosting and defensive items will help her to survive, allowing Exorcism to last longer during team fights. Furthermore she also can use Spirit Siphon as pseudo-lifesteal on single or multiple enemies which makes her harder to kill.
Stacks diminishingly with other magic resistance sources.
Grants bonus attack damage.
The health talent increases the max health capacity and keeps the current health percentage.

Death Prophet is best played in the middle lane, easily farming up gold for her items with careful use of Crypt Swarm. Be cautious though as pushing too much with the area damage can leave Death Prophet open to ganks, from which her only means of defense is Spirit Siphon, which is never guaranteed to ensure her survival.

All of Death Prophet's spells are area of effect, excluding Spirit Siphon. This means they cannot block Death Prophet's spell with Linken's Sphere. While Spirit Siphon can be negated by it, you can use extra charges to cast it again afterwards.
Although Death Prophet has high base movement speed, she lacks escape abilities. One hard disable can bring you down if there are no reinforcements nearby.

In a large clash, Death Prophet should be swooping around silencing and nuking enemy supports while eroding their health with Exorcism. Carries almost unfailingly have higher armor than supports, and since Exorcism is physical damage, her damage potential is highest when she focuses on the supports.

Given her above-average base movement speed and Phase Boots, Death Prophet moves extremely fast and can often avoid damage simply by being faster than her aggressor. A Eul's Scepter of Divinity is also a common pickup on her and increases her movement speed to phenomenal levels. Death Prophet tends to chase people around a lot with Exorcism, so high movement speed is a must and can also help the spirits damage enemies around Death Prophet while she is safe.

Coordinated teams will often focus Death Prophet first to avoid being overwhelmed by Exorcism. It′s imperative to be cautious about your positioning so your Spirit Siphon and Exorcism can ramp up in damage. Teammates with strong defensive abilities or items should focus on keeping you alive wherever possible.

Crypt Swarm is a very powerful area of effect nuke which damages enemies in a cone-shaped area. Its power falls off later in the game, but it can still clear creep waves with two uses, between which the cooldown should be very short at that point.
The target range of Crypt Swarm is 600 but it can travel up to 1110 range maximum, do not hesitate to harass laning enemy heroes to force them to retreat to their defensive towers.
Crypt Swarm is a dual sided target ability that can be targeted both onto a unit or the ground. Usually it is much easier to target the ground due to the short casting range of the spell.

Crypt Swarm can be used to kill enemy lane creeps with ease, as well as to prevent the enemy from denying them as the damage is higher than any hero's basic attacks during the early game. At the same time it can harass the enemy hero with some clever positioning.

Although Crypt Swarm has large area of effect, some enemy heroes can easily avoid Crypt Swarm by just looking at your long cast animation. Mid heroes like Puck (using Phase Shift) or Templar Assassin (using Refraction) can easily nullify your damage.

Since Crypt Swarm has a low cooldown and is also spamable, though as the skill level goes higher, the mana consumption will increase as well. Try to maintain your mana by avoiding careless use of the ability in the laning phrase.
Crypt Swarm is typically maxed first as it is a very strong AoE nuke with low cooldown, followed by Spirit Siphon, which helps her sustain in lane and survive teamfights.
Silence is a powerful utility disable which prevent enemies from casting spells for up to 6 seconds at max level.

Silence has a nice long 900 cast range which can safely be cast at far distances and also has a big 425 area of effect, try to silence as many heroes as possible. The long range silence are also great to cancel powerful channeling ultimate abilities such as Black Hole, Fiend's Grip, Freezing Field and Death Ward, provided that they are not affected by spell immunity.
Some players might take one level of Silence during laning phase or early team fights, especially when facing hard spellcaster heroes that interrupt your actions, so she can secure a kill easily.

Remember that Silence can be dispelled by enemies, smart players can purchase dispel items such as Eul's Scepter of Divinity, Guardian Greaves, Lotus Orb, Manta Style to remove the silence debuff. But silence is also a great way to force them to activate Black King Bar for the dispel, which will later weaken them during a team fight.

Silence also good against heroes with powerful buffs like Ursa's Overpower, Enrage and Lifestealer's Rage which require their spell to cast; just make sure that you inflict them with silence before they cast it.
Put a single point in Silence early if the enemy is reliant on spell casting, such as Dazzle, Leshrac or Lion.
Spirit Siphon that drains the enemy's health and movement speed to sustain and buff Death Prophet during team fights.

The sprite animation of Spirit Siphon works similar to Pugna's Life Drain. Unlike Pugna, she can move freely during drain until the target enemy moves outside of the break range of 750, the drain duration ends or the enemy dies. Drain and healing will continue even if the target or Death Prophet becomes disabled or invulnerable. Smart players can predict enemies movement with slow animation disables like Storm Hammer or Wraithfire Blast to recover the damage taken.

The health drain scales with the target enemy's max HP. The more HP that enemy is, the more health you will be drain. Although health drain scales with the enemy's max HP, the damage type is magical which is reduced by magic resistance.
Death Prophet can use Spirit Siphon on creeps but not Roshan.

Spirit Siphon is a charge-based spell like Earth Spirit's Stone Remnant that can store up to 4 charges at max level. Besides level 1, you can cast on a single enemy after the duration finishes and cast it again without waiting for a cooldown unless you had one charge left.

Spirit Siphon can be cast on multiple targets at once, provided enough charges are available, allowing Death Prophet to replenish health very rapidly if she is standing in the middle of the enemy team.

Exorcism is a fantastic pushing ultimate that can easily take down towers and Roshan if left unhindered. Fighting into an activated Exorcism is quite dangerous as well, which means hindering her is not easy.

Always remember Exorcism's damage is physical, hence, armor reduction increases its damage. Focusing on targets with low armor (intelligence and many strength heroes) yields the best result of Exorcism. That said, its damage is a threat even to targets with very high armor, and those carrying a Black King Bar.
The Exorcism spirits have a travel time and after each attack must return to Death Prophet. The closer you stand to a target, the less the spirits have to travel, thus dealing more overall damage.

Use Exorcism as early as it is practically possible for clashes, as the sooner it is cast the sooner her spirits will return and heal her. Her spirits will easily harvest enough life to restore her HP entirely, and the conclusion of her ultimate can save Death Prophet's life as well as severely endanger the lives of her adversaries as she returns to battle with full health.

bio:
Долгие годы Кробелус служила пророчицей. Её услуги очень высоко ценились, и лишь богатейшие могли позволить себе заглянуть за порог смерти её глазами. В конце концов Кробелус захотелось узнать, что же судьба уготовила для неё самой. Но в этот раз смерть отказалась открывать свои тайны. В сердцах пророчица решила заплатить самым дорогим — своей жизнью. Однако и этого оказалось недостаточно.

Алчная смерть отвергала её снова и снова, отказываясь раскрывать свои потаённые секреты. В Кробелус начала расти зависть. «Если остальным дано умереть навсегда — почему не могу я? Почему я вновь и вновь возвращаюсь к бренной жизни? Почему меня лишили того единственного, что остальные смертные принимают как должное?» — негодовала она.

Несмотря на преграды, Кробелус не оставляла свои попытки. Каждый раз, поднимаясь из могилы, она несла с собой частичку смерти. С ней возвращались тени умерших — порой казалось, что это её собственная душа раздробилась на множество осколков. Кровь её все сильнее блекла и стала более походить на эктоплазму, а обитатели сумеречных миров уже начали принимать её за свою. Умирая, каждый раз пророчица лишалась крупицы жизни, и ей уже начало казаться, что конец близок. Теперь ещё с большим рвением Кробелус бросается в объятья смерти в попытках осуществить собственное несбывшееся пророчество, в надежде, что однажды смерть заберёт её раз и навсегда.
trivia: По какой-то причине, она, вместе с Io и Silencer, поменяла цветовую палитру своих способностей и одежды. До того, одеяние Death Prophet’s и иконки способностей были более фиолетового цвета .
Иконка для одной из старых способностей, Witchcraft, изображалась в виде пентаграммы, символа колдовства в религии Викка.

notes.text: При выборе существа Crypt Swarm выпускается по направлению его текущего расположения.
Crypt Swarm летит со скоростью 1100, пролетая все расстояние за 0,74 секунды.
Учитывая дальность полёта и конечный радиус, может поражать существ на расстоянии до 1110.
Площадь поражения по форме похожа на конус.
Призывает 1 духа от Exorcism за каждое задетое существо. Приоритетом атаки таких духов будут задетые цели, даже если полученный урон от самой способности был равен 0.
Духи не появляются, если цели умирают от Crypt Swarm.
Если Exorcism не изучена, духи не будут появляться.

notes: Задевает существ на расстоянии до 1100 единиц.
Эту способность нельзя заблокировать или отразить.
abilities.lore: Во время своих путешествий в загробный мир Кробелус забирает с собой души проклятых, материализуя их стаей летучих мышей в нашем мире.
abilities.description: Посылает вперёд стаю крылатых тварей, наносящих урон врагам на своём пути.
abilities.name: Crypt Swarm

notes.text: Снаряд летит со скоростью 1200.
Учитывая дальность применения и радиус действия, может задеть противников на расстоянии до 1350.
Применяет дебафф на врагов по области применения. Вхождение или покидание области после применения не даст эффекта.
Призывает 1 духа от Exorcism за каждое задетое существо. Приоритетом атаки таких духов будут задетые цели, даже если полученный урон от самой способности был равен 0.
Если Exorcism не изучена, духи не будут появляться.

abilities.lore: Кробелус видит лишь безмолвное будущее, вглядываясь в смертное предначертание своего врага.
abilities.description: Выпускает снаряд, который запрещает врагам в указанной области применять способности.
abilities.name: Silence

notes.text: При изучении способности, повышении её уровня и при покупке Aghanim's Shard Death Prophent сразу получает 1 заряд.
Связь разрывается только если цель заклинания или заклинатель умрет или расстояние между ними превысит дистанцию действия.
Бонусы к дальности применения также увеличивают дистанцию разрыва связи.у
Восстановление здоровья для Death Prophet независимо от фактического количества нанесённого урона.
Spirit Siphon сначала наносит урон, затем лечит заклинателя.
Наносит урон и лечит на 6,25/12,5/18,75/25 (13,75/20/26,25/32,5) каждые 0,25 сек. спустя 0,25 сек. после применения, в результате срабатывая 24 раз.
Может нанести урон/излечить на 150/300/450/600 (330/480/630/780) единиц здоровья за всё время действия связи (до учёта сопротивлений).
Не может быть применена на существо, уже находящееся под эффектом Spirit Siphon, пока дебафф не будет развеян.
Нельзя применить на Рошана.
Каждое успешное применение связи накладывает новый бафф на Death Prophet. Это значит, что их урон, интервал нанесения урона, лечение и длительность не зависят друг от друга.
Не дает обзор на цель, при этом связь не рвется при потере обзора.
При потере обзора цели, связь визуально рисует то место, где цель была видна последний раз.
Создаёт 1 духа Exorcism при применении, в приоритете будет связанная цель.
Если Exorcism не изучена, духи не будут создаваться.
При улучшении с Aghanim's Shard Spirit Siphon будет накладывать страх после 3-x секунд действия связи.
Эффект страха применяется при помощи баффа от связи на Death Prophet, а не дебаффа на цели, поэтому даже если дебафф был развеян, страх будет наложен.
Страх не может быть применён к неуязвимой или спрятанной цели в течение 3-х секунд.
Страх от Spirit Siphon вынуждает противников бежать от заклинателя, а не к фонтану своей команды. Враги под эффектом страха не могут выполнять приказы.
Выбор увеличивающего урон и лечение таланта не действует на текущее применение.
/ Мгновенно получает все заряды при краже этой способности впервые.
Может быть применена на одно существо дважды, если применить на вторую цель в то время, когда первая цель уже находится под действием Spirit Siphon

notes: На каждую цель может действовать только одна связь.
abilities.lore: Кробелус охотно покажет другим путь, по которому ей не пройти в одиночку.
abilities.description: Герой создаёт мистическую связь с вражеским существом, передавая его здоровье себе.
abilities.name: Spirit Siphon
abilities.shard: Увеличивает максимум зарядов на 1 и накладывает на врагов 1 сек. страха, если способность действует на них 3 сек. подряд.

abilities.description: Полученный опыт расширяет оккультные знания героя: с каждым уровнем его скорость передвижения увеличивается, а перезарядки заклинаний уменьшаются.
abilities.name: Witchcraft

notes.text: Духи появляются вокруг Death Prophet с интервалом в 0,35 секунды сразу после применения; для появления всех духов нужно 2,45/5,25/8,05 (5,25/8,05/10,85) секунды.
Духи не являются существами, поэтому с ними нельзя взаимодействовать или чем-то на них повлиять.
Духи движутся со скоростью 525, витая в радиусе 700 вокруг Death Prophet.
На дальность атаки духов не влияют ни бонусы к дальности атаки, ни бонусы к дальности применения.
Духи могут разворачиваться только путем движения по дуге с радиусом ≈150.

Каждый из духов выбирает свою цель случайно, но они следуют следующим приоритетам: существа, которых атакует Death Prophet ➤ существа, находящиеся рядом с Death Prophet ➤ существа, находящиеся в радиусе действия.
При выборе цели дух обычно преследует юнита до его смерти, выхода из зоны действия или до выбора новой цели героем.
Преследование нельзя отменить. Дух прервет его после достижения цели или если расстояние между ним и целью превысит 1900 единиц.
То есть с выбором новой цели Death Prophet уже атакующие духи не переключаются на новую.
Духи не наносят урон существам, находящимся более чем в 1200 единицах от Death Prophet, хотя могут преследовать на гораздо большее расстояние.
Для повторной атаки духи должны вернуться к Death Prophet после каждой совершенной.
Духи могут атаковать любой доступное для атаки вражеское существо, включая постройки, варды и существ в тумане войны.
Духи не могут атаковать:
Невидимых существ.
Варды, которые требуют фиксированное количество атак для уничтожения.
Нетленных зомби.
Неуязвимых и бесплотных существ, но продолжат пытаться нанести урон противнику, если он был выбран в качестве цели до получения этих эффектов.
Урон духов считается уроном от заклинаний, поэтому он взаимодействует с усилением урона от заклинаний и вампиризмом заклинаниями.
Атаки духов не считаются обычными атаками, поэтому они игнорируют такие вещи, как уклонение и блокировка урона.
Духи также не могут активировать эффекты, срабатывающие на атаки, такие как Counter Helix, Moment of Courage и Reactive Armor, и не могут сбить врагу Tranquil Boots.
Аванпосты считаются доступными целями, несмотря на то, что их нельзя атаковать.
Курьеры обладают самым низким приоритетом для атаки. Они будут получать урон только в том случае, если не будет других целей для атаки.
Если дух улетел на расстояние более 2000 единиц от Death Prophet, он исчезает и появляется рядом с ней.
Появление таких духов связано с интервалами появления, поэтому несколько исчезнувших духов не появятся одновременно возле героя.
Лечение происходит единоразово при возвращении духов обратно к Death Prophet с завершением длительность способности. Духи не лечат героя при возвращении после каждой атаки.
Лечение от духов основано на значении их урона, а не фактически нанесенном уроне.
То есть после возврата духи излечат Death Prophet на 15,5 ‒ 16,75 (7,75 ‒ 8,375) за каждую совершенную атаку вне зависимости от того, получили ли враги урон или нет.
Суммарно даёт 20%/26%/32% бонусной скорости передвижения во время действия способности.
Повторное применение Exorcism досрочно прервет предыдущее применение, заставляя духов вернутся к Death Prophet и исцелить.
Духи пассивно призываются для каждого существа, задетого Crypt Swarm и Silence, целей Spirit Siphon. Они не появляются при применении предметов или других способностей.
Также духи появляются от обычных и мгновенных атак Death Prophet, в том числе по постройкам
Духи не появляются от атак по вардам или по союзным существам.
Духи также не появляются, если атака героя промахнулась или её избежали
Пассивно появляющиеся духи действуют как духи, вызванные применением, и у них также есть максимальное расстояние.
Духи преследуют свои цели в течение 20 сек. до того момента, как прекратят это делать и вернутся к Death Prophet.
Пассивно появляющиеся духи наносят 93 ‒ 101 (47 ‒ 50) урона, поэтому излечивает заклинателя на 23 ‒ 25 единиц здоровья при возвращении.
Улучшение от Aghanim's Scepter не увеличивает урон от уже появившихся духов.

notes: Радиус указывает область вокруг героя, в которой духи выбирают цель.
Урон от духов не уменьшается способностями, блокирующими урон.
abilities.lore: Осколки неисчислимых прошлых жизней банши материализуются, чтобы сеять ужас в настоящем.
abilities.scepter: Создаёт духа каждый раз, когда владелец попадает по врагу способностью или совершает атаку. Дух летит к жертве, наносит ей увеличенный урон, а затем возвращается и восстанавливает владельцу здоровье.
abilities.description: Герой выпускает злых духов, вытягивающих здоровье из вражеских существ и построек поблизости. После каждой атаки дух должен вернуться к владельцу, прежде чем атаковать вновь. Через 40 сек. духи возвращаются окончательно, исцеляя владельца на долю от нанесённого урона. Постройки получают 50% урона.
abilities.name: Exorcism

hype: Своей армией призраков Death Prophet уничтожает как противников, так и их постройки. Возглавив наступление и выпуская одну смертоносную волну за другой, она может повергнуть врагов в отчаяние.
name: Death Prophet

talents.left: Смерти во время Exorcism продлевают действие на 8 сек.
